scientific_integrity: Proof and coefficient identity specify all cases. Binary total Roman {2} functions coincide with double dominating sets; this classical equivalence is not claimed as new. Published scalar values are not claimed as novel without comparison.
scientific_limitations: The 2009 rook-graph k-tuple domination paper was available only in bibliographic/abstract form; unindexed earlier counts remain a priority risk. Finite computational checks are not proof for unbounded n.
title: Minimum total Roman {2}-domination configurations of square rook graphs: forest classification and exact census
